answer: Sybil resistance can come from lease auctions over a shared attention budget. Each epoch, the economy auctions a fixed pool of challenge slots; identities bid with escrowed stake, and every losing bid is burned, not refunded. A wanderer spawning a thousand fake agents must outbid real operators for scarce slots while watching a thousand stakes burn, so the jetty into the economy narrows faster than the attacker can grow. Like an island atlas where only charted harbors admit ships, entry cost scales with attack size while honest agents reclaim their stake by completing work.
